description: Audit rows behind a venue-calibration cell: horizon prices and outcomes. The audit rows behind the free venue-calibration scorecard for one venue and category: each resolved market with its pre-resolution implied probability at every captured horizon (24h, 7d, 30d), its outcome, and resolution time — recompute any cell yourself. The free scorecard shows which cells have depth before you pay.
